en.label: Filter (JQL)
en.hint: The inbox syncs every 15 minutes. Defaults to unfinished issues assigned to you. Filter bugs with an issuetype condition, e.g. issuetype = Bug AND (use the type name configured in your Jira).

settings.label: 筛选条件（JQL）
settings.default: assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC
settings.hint: 收件箱每 15 分钟按它同步一次。默认是分给你、还没完成的 issue；只看 bug 可以在前面加上 issuetype 条件，例如 issuetype = Bug AND（类型名以你们 Jira 里的为准）。
